title: Bag of mice
statementMd:
The dragon and the princess are arguing about what to do on the New Year's Eve. The dragon suggests flying to the mountains to watch fairies dancing in the moonlight, while the princess thinks they should just go to bed early. They are desperate to come to an amicable agreement, so they decide to leave this up to chance.

They take turns drawing a mouse from a bag which initially contains $*w*$ white and $*b*$ black mice. The person who is the first to draw a white mouse wins. After each mouse drawn by the dragon the rest of mice in the bag panic, and one of them jumps out of the bag itself (the princess draws her mice carefully and doesn't scare other mice). **Princess draws first.** What is the probability of the princess winning?

If there are no more mice in the bag and nobody has drawn a white mouse, the dragon wins. Mice which jump out of the bag themselves are not considered to be drawn (do not define the winner). Once a mouse has left the bag, it never returns to it. Every mouse is drawn from the bag with the same probability as every other one, and every mouse jumps out of the bag with the same probability as every other one.

## Input

The only line of input data contains two integers $*w*$ and $*b*$ ($0 ≤ *w*, *b* ≤ 1000$).

## Output

Output the probability of the princess winning. The answer is considered to be correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

Let's go through the first sample. The probability of the princess drawing a white mouse on her first turn and winning right away is 1/4. The probability of the dragon drawing a black mouse and not winning on his first turn is 3/4 * 2/3 = 1/2. After this there are two mice left in the bag — one black and one white; one of them jumps out, and the other is drawn by the princess on her second turn. If the princess' mouse is white, she wins (probability is 1/2 * 1/2 = 1/4), otherwise nobody gets the white mouse, so according to the rule the dragon wins.
statementZhMd:
龙和公主正在争论除夕夜该做什么。龙提议飞到山里去看仙女在月光下跳舞，而公主认为他们应该早点睡觉。他们非常希望达成一个友好的协议，于是决定把这件事交给运气。

他们轮流从一个袋子里抽出一只老鼠，袋子里最初有 $*w*$ 只白老鼠和 $*b*$ 只黑老鼠。第一个抽到白老鼠的人获胜。每当龙抽出一只老鼠后，袋子里的其他老鼠都会惊慌失措，其中一只会自行跳出袋子（公主抽老鼠时十分小心，不会惊吓到其他老鼠）。**公主先抽。** 公主获胜的概率是多少？

如果袋子里已经没有老鼠，并且没有人抽到白老鼠，则龙获胜。自行跳出袋子的老鼠不算作被抽出的老鼠（不会决定胜者）。老鼠一旦离开袋子，就不会再回到袋子里。每只老鼠被从袋子中抽出的概率都相同，每只老鼠自行跳出袋子的概率也都相同。

## 输入格式

输入数据仅一行，包含两个整数 $*w*$ 和 $*b*$（$0 ≤ *w*, *b* ≤ 1000$）。

## 输出格式

输出公主获胜的概率。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则认为答案正确。

## 说明

让我们分析第一个样例。公主在第一回合抽到白老鼠并立即获胜的概率是 1/4。龙在第一回合抽到黑老鼠且没有获胜的概率是 3/4 * 2/3 = 1/2。此时袋子里还剩两只老鼠——一只黑老鼠和一只白老鼠；其中一只会跳出袋子，另一只会被公主在第二回合抽出。如果公主抽到的是白老鼠，她就会获胜（概率为 1/2 * 1/2 = 1/4）；否则没有人抽到白老鼠，因此根据规则龙获胜。
